profile.twoFactorDesc: Add an extra layer of security to your account

profile.closeAccountDesc: Before you do this, please note that account deletion is irreversible.
profile.closeDialogTitle: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
profile.closeDialogDesc: This action cannot be undone. If you delete your account:
profile.closeDialogPoint1: We delete your profile (name, email address, phone number, password, two-factor settings and links to sign-in providers such as Google), your saved addresses, wishlist and newsletter subscription.
profile.closeDialogPoint2: We delete your customer profile at our payment provider Stripe, together with your saved cards.
profile.closeDialogPoint3: We delete your sign-in history and the record of your activity in the shop, and sign you out on every device.
profile.closeDialogPoint4: Your orders and payments, with the names, addresses, contact and invoice details on them, stay in our accounting records for 5 years from the end of the year of each order, because accounting and tax law requires it. They are no longer linked to an account, so you will not see them here.
